scenario.normal.detail: Every path is up. Now and then a single sample fails, below the confirmation threshold, so it shows only as a warning.
scenario.transit-blocked.detail: Public connections from home and relay to transit (BandwagonHost) time out while ICMP still answers and the tailnet relays through DERP; remote observers still get through → counter-evidence and a path-specific fault hypothesis. Fallback takes over.
scenario.transit-down.detail: Transit (BandwagonHost) answers no observer, tailnet included; primary chain breaks and backup chains take over.
scenario.exit-down.detail: Chains through Oracle Exit A fail while Vultr Exit B in Hawaii still works → the exit candidates are degraded.
scenario.exit-drift.detail: Requests succeed but the exit IP is outside the declared range → a policy violation, not an outage.
scenario.cross-border-loss.detail: Cross-border samples fail 35% of the time with latency ×2.6; states flap between warning and down.
scenario.home-offline.detail: The Windows and MacBook workers stop reporting (stale, then unknown, after a few tens of seconds); the reverse proxy cannot reach the home dashboard and visitors get a 502.
scenario.relay-down.detail: The whole relay host is gone: the DERP relay, the reverse proxy and the relay observer disappear together.
scenario.aux-maintenance.detail: Checks involving the aux host go into maintenance (no alerts); backup line and private services are not judged.
scenario.remote-clock-skew.detail: The remote worker's clock runs 40 seconds fast; its samples are not taken as current results.
scenario.app-origin-down.detail: Application origin answers nothing: visitors get a 521 through Cloudflare while the edge keeps answering → the main site and API fail, but Cloudflare has evidence of answering and origin is only marked affected; the app observer goes offline with it.
scenario.edge-blocked.detail: Home observers cannot reach the Cloudflare edge (timeouts, no answer at all); remote observers answer as usual → the fault lies before the edge and is not blamed on the origin.
scenario.chaos.detail: Every check breaks at random in 30-second windows (about 15%), with random latency spikes.
scenario.collector-unreachable.detail: The TUI gets no new snapshots: the cache is kept, but everything shows as unknown / CACHED.
scenario.host-cpu-high.detail: Synthetic CPU use rises to 97–99%; configured CPU thresholds produce a policy incident.
scenario.host-memory-high.detail: Synthetic physical memory use rises to 96–98%; configured memory thresholds produce a policy incident.
scenario.host-disk-full.detail: Synthetic filesystem capacity use rises to 98–99%; configured disk thresholds produce a policy incident.
scenario.host-process-missing.detail: The configured process has zero non-zombie matches; a positive minimum produces a policy incident.
scenario.edge-challenge: Cloudflare challenge for the relay observer
scenario.edge-challenge.detail: The San Jose DigitalOcean relay's requests to a Cloudflare-fronted origin get a 403 challenge page (`cf-mitigated: challenge`) while remote observers still get through. The edge answered, the origin was not asked, and the origin's own state is not established.
scenario.edge-rerouted.detail: The San Jose DigitalOcean relay's Cloudflare answers arrive from LAX instead of SJC while its check declares SJC and SEA → a policy violation, not an outage: the requests succeed and nothing fails.
scenario.tunnel-down.detail: The home box's cloudflared connector reports no ready edge session, so its link reads down; the public hostname gets 530 from the edge, which proves the edge only, while the loopback check still proves the dashboard.
scenario.certificate-expiring.detail: The certificate of the first host whose checks declare tls_min_days has 9 days left, inside their warning window → a policy warning on those checks while every request still succeeds.
node.win.notes: mihomo + Tailscale; local home services run here
node.relay.notes: Self-hosted DERP relay + reverse proxy to home devices
node.transit.notes: Carries only the VLESS+Reality entry and runs nothing else
node.app.notes: The main web server, serving applications to the public
node.aux.notes: Auxiliary services, storage indexer and backup transit node
node.cf.notes: Anycast edge in front of origins; runs Workers and Pages
node.vercel.notes: Personal Next.js app; functions in region hnd1
observer.obs-win.context: Windows native; Clash Verge TUN active
observer.obs-mac.context: macOS native; Clash Verge system proxy
observer.obs-relay.context: Relay cloud vantage point; loopback probe
observer.obs-app.context: East coast cloud vantage; application loopback
endpoint.transit-entry.notes: VLESS+Reality entry port; TCP connect does not equal proxy authentication
endpoint.app-db-tn.notes: TCP port check only, not a SQL query
endpoint.supabase-rest.notes: REST gateway health check; not a SQL query
service.backup-job.notes: Registered only; does not fake heartbeats without real receipts
notes.socks-listener: Dedicated socks listener pre-configured in Clash Verge
path.egress.notes: Corresponding to Clash Verge fallback group
path.rem-relay.notes: Internal proxy forward; middle hops opaque
observer.host.context: Local host resource worker; synthetic preview
check.host-resources.notes: Synthetic CPU, memory, local filesystem and process counters. Local telemetry does not prove remote reachability.
link.home-cf.notes: Outbound Tunnel from the home box to Cloudflare. The connector's own report decides this link; the check through the edge proves the edge only.
